_: Eguahe, the bottle sticker (Apli 01294, 70 x 16.9 mm, 51 per sheet), by the art director. Units are millimetres; 1x is 300 ppi. The font is the one of the backpack label.

name.rule: the name shrinks to fit between left and right, and if a capital with an accent would rise above room_up, it shrinks too; never under min_size

how: fill a canvas with the centre colour through the band mask, put the paper layer over it, write the name
